absent: Values and update paths for tolerance and epoch period and cache activation beyond observed reads.
Full layouts of runqueue and task and domain and CFS structures beyond observed fields.
Unthrottle and period expiry paths that clear throttled state and replenish runtime.
Delayed entity lifecycle including set and clear paths and their locking.
NUMA balancing interaction beyond veto condition on node mismatch.
Extensible scheduler root lifecycle and watchdog timeout configuration and exit handling.
Tickless idle balance execution after kick and blocked load decay.
PELT sum and average formulae and trace definitions behind load refresh.
Donor selection in proxy execution and core tick behaviour.
Housekeeping and frequency and hardware pressure scaling implementations.

findings.text: Periodic scheduler tick and balance trigger are globally visible core services that drive per CPU accounting and request deferred balancing work when due.
Bandwidth period starter and CFS runtime charging helper are globally visible for quota control, enabling period activation and execution docking against throttlable groups.
Load average refresh helpers for realtime and deadline and hardware plus their aggregate are globally visible for use by tick and extensible scheduler paths.
Reschedule latency warning emitter and extensible scheduler tick hooks are globally visible, with both an active watchdog checking variant and a disabled empty variant present.
Weak default asymmetric CPU priority provider is globally visible and orders higher numbered CPUs as less preferred unless overridden by architecture code.
Scheduler tick serves as the periodic per CPU timer entry that updates clocks and pressure, delegates to the donor class tick, samples stall latency, and triggers balancing after releasing locks.
Early boot string hook serves as the init entry that parses and stores the reschedule latency warning threshold.

Cache tolerance mapping disables aggregation when tolerance is cleared, saturates to an extreme maximum once tolerance reaches a high threshold, and otherwise grows with the caller supplied multiplier.
Capacity fit test treats load as fitting only when it sits comfortably below the limit by a fixed proportional headroom.

LLC aggregation validity excludes single threaded tasks outright, accepts multithreaded tasks unconditionally under saturated tolerance, and otherwise compares scaled thread demand against scaled LLC size.

Preferred LLC selection propagates absence when no cache group or CPU is assigned, otherwise maps the assigned CPU to its LLC, with NUMA balancing able to veto a choice that conflicts with node preference.
LLC identity lookup reports absence for invalid CPUs and otherwise reads a per CPU LLC identifier.
LLC enqueue accounting ignores negative preferences and otherwise increments runqueue occupancy and domain census while snapshotting whether placement matched preference at enqueue time.
Preferred runnable counting applies only when the enqueue snapshot shows preferred placement and the entity is not delayed.
LLC dequeue symmetrically reverses enqueue occupancy, clears the placement snapshot, and guards domain census against transient underflow after topology rebuild.
CPU epoch and cache time epoch advance monotonically with time using a clamped period, decaying accumulated runtime by elapsed periods so old history ages away.
Sixty four bit decay yields zero once shift distance reaches word width and otherwise shifts logically.
Task load contribution is recognized only while the task remains on the queried CPU with existing averaging state and queued status.
Scheduler statistics storage resolves to group CFS state for non task entities under group scheduling and to task storage otherwise.
Buddy cleanup touches only the next pointer and only when it currently references the supplied entity.
CFS runtime charging is bypassed when bandwidth control is unused or disabled for the queue, otherwise docking execution and reporting whether the queue is throttled.
Throttling first seeks fresh runtime with a larger request for currently runnable hierarchies and a minimal request otherwise, throttling only when no runtime can be granted.
Bandwidth slice duration derives from a sysctl value scaled from microseconds to nanoseconds.
Runtime assignment covers shortfall from infinite quota without limit or from finite pooled runtime after ensuring period activity, then reports whether the queue became runnable.
Throttle deferral work is installed at most once per task and never for exiting or kernel thread contexts, targeting resume time.

Reschedule latency sampling stays silent during boot and without pending reschedule or when disabled or on first sight or below threshold, otherwise counting ticks under stall and reporting elapsed time.
Tick accounting and class tick dispatch follow the donor task to support proxy execution rather than always using the current task.
Extensible scheduler tick exits with stall status when watchdog checkins are overdue and otherwise refreshes other class averages.
Null domain attachment is defined by absence of a runqueue domain pointer under RCU style observation.
Balance triggering is suppressed on null domains or inactive CPUs, requests scheduler softirq when the next balance time has arrived, and always evaluates tickless kick logic.

Tickless kick logic suppresses work for idle balancing CPUs and for future balance times without pending statistics, then escalates to balance kicks for overload and capacity and misfit and packing and shared LLC busyness.
Reduced capacity compares effective capacity scaled by imbalance tolerance against architectural capacity, while misfit status follows a nonzero misfit load indicator.
Asymmetric packing preference combines domain packing enablement with SMT activity and capacity sharing or core idleness plus architectural priority ordering.
Cache aware scheduling activation is observed through an unlikely static branch, and aggregate other average refresh reports whether any realtime or deadline or hardware or irq component changed.
CPU epoch update requires holding the runqueue epoch lock, asserted on entry before touching epoch counters and decayed runtime.
Bandwidth runtime assignment and period start require holding the bandwidth lock, asserted on entry, with throttling acquiring that lock only around assignment and throttled list linkage.
Throttled hierarchy average freezing runs under RCU protection while throttled list membership is ordered by the bandwidth lock and completion by the runqueue lock.
Checked scheduler domain dereference validates that the domains mutex is held, while runqueue domain and shared structure reads in LLC and tickless paths use lockless RCU style dereference.
Periodic tick holds the runqueue lock across clock and pressure and class tick and load updates, releasing before emitting latency warnings and invoking perf or worker hooks.
Aggregate other average refresh requires holding the runqueue lock, asserted on entry.

Observed runqueue state includes LLC occupancy counters for total and preferred placement, a domain pointer, epoch values with next deadline and decayed runtime, plus stall tracking with last seen time and tick count and balance timing.

Observed task preference state includes a preferred LLC identifier with negative meaning none, a snapshot flag for preferred placement at enqueue, a delayed marker gating runnable counting, plus NUMA node preference and throttle work linkage.
Observed domain census state includes a maximum LLC index that bounds a counts array indexed by preferred LLC.
Observed CFS queue throttle state includes remaining runtime with enabled and throttled flags, a throttled clock marker, a throttled list node, and hierarchy current and group linkage.
Observed bandwidth control state includes quota and pooled runtime with idle and period active flags, period duration with timer, plus a lock and a throttled queue list.
Observed cache group and cache time state include a running average with assigned CPU plus epoch and decayed runtime values.

LLC snapshot flag moves from clear to set at enqueue based on placement match, persists across topology changes, and returns to clear at dequeue or when delayed handling removes preferred counting to block later re addition.
CFS queue moves from runnable to throttled on runtime exhaustion when fresh assignment fails, acquiring list membership and throttled marking with deferred work for runnable hierarchies.
Bandwidth period moves from inactive to active on first finite assignment needing runtime, forwarding and arming an absolute pinned timer and remaining active until outside period handling completes.
Reschedule latency warning latches from unwarned to warned on first over threshold stall when once mode is enabled, suppressing later samples.
Cache and bandwidth and extensible tick features select between active behaviour and compiled out no operation variants that return absence or false or do nothing.
Domain rebuild on hotplug can zero LLC census between enqueue and dequeue, causing transient undercount that requires guarding the decrement.
LLC identity can change after enqueue due to hotplug, so re evaluating placement at dequeue would corrupt preferred counts and the enqueue snapshot must be used instead.
Delayed entities risk double counting in preferred totals unless enqueue and dequeue both skip delayed state in coordination with the snapshot flag and delay clear path.
Bandwidth can appear concurrently with a throttle decision and cause an unnecessary full period stall unless minimal runtime probing detects availability first.
Extended need reschedule without scheduling signals a stall that must be sampled under runqueue lock but reported after release with rate limiting to avoid log flood.
Overdue extensible scheduler watchdog checkin signals control plane stall and must force scheduler exit rather than continue normal accounting.
Cache tolerance uses zero for disabled and one hundred for saturation, with saturated scale reported as integer maximum.
Capacity fit uses factors twelve eighty and ten twenty four, while LLC and CPU absence use negative one and LLC accounting ignores negative preferences.
CFS throttle minimal request is one nanosecond, slice scales microseconds to nanoseconds, and infinite quota bypasses pooled limits.
Throttle work filtering uses exiting and kernel thread flags with resume trigger, and latency warnings rate limit to one per hour.
Packing decisions use domain packing and capacity sharing flags, and weak default CPU priority orders by negated CPU number.
